The patient has low blood pressure and received intravenous normal saline, which are both consistent with hypovolemic shock.
The patient has severe metabolic acidosis, which is consistent with diabetic ketoacidosis and acute renal failure.
The patient has vascular dementia, which is consistent with his history of ischemic stroke and peripheral arterial disease.

The patient has bilateral nonobstructive renal artery stenosis and acute renal failure, which are both consistent with chronic kidney disease.
The patient has peripheral arterial disease, which is consistent with his history of ischemic stroke and vascular dementia.
It explains the uncovered finding of chronic right internal carotid occlusion.
